1

Set the role + rubric

FAQ

Common questions from hiring teams.

What does AI Interviewer produce at the end of an interview?

A structured report with a competency breakdown, key evidence, strengths, risks/red flags, and an overall recommendation your team can calibrate on.

Is this meant to replace human interviews?

No. It's designed to standardize early rounds and improve consistency so your team can spend more time on high-signal, human-led conversations.

Can we use our own rubrics and question styles?

Yes. You can align interviews to role-specific competencies and keep evaluation criteria consistent across candidates.

What roles does it support?

It's designed for technical, behavioral, and customer-facing roles (sales / customer success), with consistent structure and reporting across types.

How do we get started?

Request a demo, tell us your roles and hiring goals, and we'll help you set up an interview flow aligned to your rubric.

Do candidates need an account?

You can run interviews through simple join links so candidates can start quickly with minimal friction.

Get a demo tailored to your roles

Tell us what you're hiring for. We'll show you a structured interview flow and the exact report your team will get.
